akhfash:1-1.t: He said ﴿صۤ وَٱلْقُرْآنِ ذِي ٱلذِّكْرِ﴾: they claim that the place of the oath('s answer) is in His word ﴿إِن كُلٌّ إِلاَّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرٌّسُلَ﴾.

akhfash:3-3.t:
And He said ﴿وَّلاَتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ﴾: they likened ﴿لاتَ﴾ to ﴿ليسَ﴾ and implied in it the noun of the agent (i.e. its subject). ﴿لاتَ﴾ only occurs with "حِين" (time). Some read ﴿وَلاتَ حينُ مناصٍ﴾ in the nominative, making it in his reading like ﴿ليسَ﴾, as though he said "there is no one", and implied the khabar (predicate). In poetry [in the khafīf metre; this is poetic witness no. 264]:
طَلَبُوا صُلْحَنَا وَلاَتَ أَوَانٍ * فَأجَبْنَا أَنْ لَيْسَ حينُ بقاءِ
(They sought peace with us when it was no time for it, and we answered that it was no time for sparing.)
He put "أَوانٍ" in the genitive: he omitted and implied "الحين" and annexed it to "أَوانٍ", because ﴿لاتَ﴾ occurs only with "الحين".

akhfash:5-5.t: And He said ﴿أَجَعَلَ ٱلآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهاً وَاحِداً﴾, just as you say: "اَتَجْعَلُ مِئةَ شاهدٍ شاهداً واحداً" (would you make a hundred witnesses a single witness?).

akhfash:33-33.t: [And] He said ﴿فَطَفِقَ مَسْحاً﴾, i.e. he stroked with a stroking.

akhfash:36-36.t: And He said ﴿رُخَآءً﴾: the accusative of ﴿رُخاءً﴾ is — and Allah knows best — on the basis of "We made it gentle with a gentleness".

celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿ص﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it. ﴿وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ﴾ i.e. of clarity, or of honour. The jawāb (answer) of this oath is omitted, i.e. the matter is not as the disbelievers of Mecca said regarding the multiplicity of gods.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ of the people of Mecca ﴿فِي عِزَّةٍ﴾ zealous pride and arrogance against faith ﴿وَشِقَاقٍ﴾ opposition and enmity towards the Prophet ﷺ.

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿كَمْ﴾ i.e. many ﴿أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ i.e. a nation among the past nations ﴿فَنَادَوْا﴾ when the punishment descended upon them ﴿وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ﴾ i.e. the time is not a time of escape. The tāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of "نَادَوْا", i.e. they cried for help while there was no refuge and no deliverance. And the disbelievers of Mecca did not take a lesson from them. [Translator's note: the printed text reads «اغْتَبَرَ»; the sense requires «اعْتَبَرَ» ("take a lesson"), which is how it is translated here.]

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿وَعَجِبُوا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾ a messenger from among themselves who warns them and makes them fear the Fire after the resurrection, and he is the Prophet ﷺ. ﴿وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ﴾ In it there is the placing of the overt noun in the position of the pronoun. ﴿هَذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ﴾

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَهًا وَاحِدًا﴾ when he said to them, "Say: there is no god but Allah", i.e. how can a single god suffice for all creation? ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ﴾ i.e. astonishing.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ﴾ from the place of their gathering at Abū Ṭālib's and their hearing there from the Prophet ﷺ, "Say: there is no god but Allah" ﴿أَنِ امْشُوا﴾ i.e. some of them saying to others, "Go on" ﴿وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَى آلِهَتِكُمْ﴾ remain firm in their worship ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا﴾ the affirmation of oneness (tawḥīd) just mentioned ﴿لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ﴾ of us.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ﴾ i.e. the religion of ʿĪsā ﴿إِنْ﴾ not ﴿هَذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ﴾ a lie.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿أَأُنْزِلَ﴾ with full pronunciation (taḥqīq) of both hamzas, and with easing (tashīl) of the second, and with the insertion of an alif between them in both ways, and without it ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ upon Muḥammad ﴿الذِّكْرُ﴾ the Quran ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِنَا﴾ while he is not the greatest or the noblest of us? i.e. it has not been sent down upon him. The Exalted said: ﴿بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي﴾ My revelation, i.e. the Quran, since they called the one who brought it a liar ﴿بَلْ لَمَّا﴾ not [yet] ﴿يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ﴾ and if they had tasted it they would have believed the Prophet ﷺ in what he brought; but believing will not benefit them then.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ﴾ the Dominant ﴿الْوَهَّابِ﴾ of prophethood and other things, so that they give it to whomever they wish?

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا﴾ If they claim that, ﴿فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ﴾ that lead to heaven, and bring the revelation, and assign it to whomever they wish. "أَمْ" in both places has the meaning of the hamza of denial (inkār).

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿جُنْدٌ مَا﴾ i.e. a contemptible host ﴿هُنَالِكَ﴾ in their calling you a liar ﴿مَهْزُومٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of "جُنْدٌ" ﴿مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ﴾ also a ṣifa of "جُنْدٌ", i.e. like the hosts of the same kind as the factions who banded together against the prophets before you; and those were subdued and destroyed, so likewise We will destroy these.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ﴾ the feminine [of the verb] with "قَوْم" is by consideration of the meaning ﴿وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ﴾ for everyone he was angry with, he used to drive in four stakes, to which he tied his hands and feet, and he would torture him.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ the thicket; they are the people of Shuʿayb, peace be upon him ﴿أُولَئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ﴾

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ not ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ of the factions ﴿إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ﴾ because when they called one of them a liar, they called all of them liars, since their call is one, namely the call to the oneness of Allah (tawḥīd) ﴿فَحَقَّ﴾ became due ﴿عِقَابِ﴾

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿وَمَا يَنْظُرُ﴾ await ﴿هَؤُلَاءِ﴾ the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً﴾ it is the blast of the Resurrection, with which the punishment befalls them ﴿مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ﴾ with fatḥa and ḍamma on the fāʾ: any return.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ when {فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ} etc. was revealed: ﴿رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا﴾ the record of our deeds ﴿قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ﴾ They said that mockingly.

celaleyn:17-17.t: The Exalted said: ﴿اصْبِرْ عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُدَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ﴾ i.e. strength in worship. He used to fast one day and break his fast one day, and stand [in prayer] for half the night, sleep a third of it, and stand for a sixth of it. ﴿إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ one who constantly returns to what pleases Allah.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ﴾ with his glorification ﴿بِالْعَشِيِّ﴾ at the time of the ʿishāʾ prayer ﴿وَالْإِشْرَاقِ﴾ at the time of ḍuḥā (forenoon), which is when the sun has risen and its light has reached its full extent.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We subjected ﴿الطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً﴾ gathered to him, glorifying with him ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ of the mountains and the birds ﴿لَهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ constantly returning to obedience to him through glorification.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ﴾ We strengthened it with guards and soldiers; thirty thousand men used to guard his miḥrāb every night ﴿وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ﴾ prophethood and soundness of judgement in affairs ﴿وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ﴾ clear and satisfying speech in every purpose.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَهَلْ﴾ the meaning of the interrogative here is wonder and the arousing of eagerness to hear what follows ﴿أَتَاكَ﴾ O Muḥammad ﴿نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ﴾ the miḥrāb of Dāwūd, i.e. his place of worship, since they were prevented from entering upon him through the door because of his being occupied with worship; i.e. [has there come to you] their news and their story?

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَى دَاوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ﴾ we are ﴿خَصْمَانِ﴾ it is said: two parties, so as to agree with the plural pronoun before it; and it is said: two [persons], with the pronoun according to its meaning, since "خَصْم" is applied to one and to more. They were two angels who came in the form of two litigants, to whom what is mentioned happened by way of a hypothetical case, in order to make Dāwūd, peace be upon him, aware of what had come from him. He had ninety-nine wives, and he asked for the wife of a man who had no one but her, married her and consummated the marriage with her. ﴿بَغَى بَعْضُنَا عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ﴾ be unjust ﴿وَاهْدِنَا﴾ guide us ﴿إِلَى سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ﴾ the middle of the right path.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا أَخِي﴾ i.e. in my religion ﴿لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً﴾ by which a woman is expressed ﴿وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا﴾ make me her guardian ﴿وَعَزَّنِي﴾ he overcame me ﴿فِي الْخِطَابِ﴾ i.e. in argument; and the other acknowledged that.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ﴾ in order to add her ﴿إِلَى نِعَاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ﴾ partners ﴿لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ﴾ the "مَا" is to emphasise the fewness. Then the two angels said, as they ascended to heaven in their [own] forms: "The man has passed judgement against himself." So Dāwūd took notice. The Exalted said: ﴿وَظَنَّ﴾ became certain ﴿دَاوُدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ﴾ We put him to a trial (fitna), i.e. an affliction, through his love for that woman ﴿فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا﴾ i.e. prostrating ﴿وَأَنَابَ﴾

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى﴾ i.e. an increase of good in this world ﴿وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ﴾ a [good] place of return in the Hereafter.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿يَا دَاوُدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ managing the affairs of the people ﴿فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَى﴾ i.e. the desire of the soul ﴿فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. from the proofs that point to His oneness ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. from faith in Allah ﴿لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا﴾ for their forgetting ﴿يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ﴾ on which their abandoning faith was consequent; had they been certain of the Day of Reckoning, they would have believed in this world.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا﴾ i.e. in vain ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the creation of what has been mentioned for no purpose ﴿ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ of the people of Mecca ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾ a valley ﴿لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ﴾

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ﴾ It was revealed when the disbelievers of Mecca said to the believers, "We will be given in the Hereafter the like of what you are given." "أَمْ" has the meaning of the hamza of denial (inkār).

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿كِتَابٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "This is" ﴿أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا﴾ its original form is "يَتَدَبَّرُوا"; the tāʾ was assimilated into the dāl ﴿آيَاتِهِ﴾ that they consider their meanings and so believe ﴿وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ﴾ take heed ﴿أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ the possessors of intellect.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ﴾ his son ﴿نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ﴾ i.e. Sulaymān ﴿إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ constantly returning in glorification and remembrance at all times.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ﴾ which is what comes after the sun passes the meridian ﴿الصَّافِنَاتُ﴾ horses, the plural of ṣāfina, which is one standing on three [legs] and setting the other on the edge of the hoof; it is from ṣafana, yaṣfinu, ṣufūnan ﴿الْجِيَادُ﴾ the plural of jawād, which is the one that outruns. The meaning is that when they are made to stand still, they are calm, and when they gallop, they outrun [others]. They were a thousand horses, displayed before him after he had prayed ẓuhr, because he intended to wage jihād on them against an enemy. When nine hundred of them had been displayed, the sun set, and he had not prayed ʿaṣr, so he was grieved.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ﴾ i.e. I wanted ﴿حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ﴾ i.e. the horses ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي﴾ the ʿaṣr prayer ﴿حَتَّى تَوَارَتْ﴾ i.e. the sun ﴿بِالْحِجَابِ﴾ i.e. it was hidden by what screens it from sight.

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ﴾ the horses that had been displayed; so they returned them ﴿فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا﴾ with the sword ﴿بِالسُّوقِ﴾ the plural of sāq (shank) ﴿وَالْأَعْنَاقِ﴾ i.e. he slaughtered them and cut off their legs as a means of drawing near to Allah the Exalted, since he had been occupied by them from the prayer, and he gave their meat in charity. So Allah compensated him with something better and swifter than them, namely the wind, which ran by his command however he wished.

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ﴾ We tested him with the removal of his kingdom. That was because of his marrying a woman he loved, who used to worship an idol in his house without his knowledge. His kingdom was in his ring; he took it off when he wanted to relieve himself and, as was his habit, left it with his wife, called al-Amīna. A jinnī came to her in the form of Sulaymān and took it from her. ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا﴾ it was that jinnī, namely Ṣakhr, or another. He sat on the throne of Sulaymān, and the birds and others gathered around him. Sulaymān came out in other than his usual appearance and saw him on his throne, and said to the people, "I am Sulaymān", but they did not recognise him. ﴿ثُمَّ أَنَابَ﴾ Sulaymān returned to his kingdom after some days, by reaching the ring, putting it on and sitting on his throne.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي﴾ shall not be ﴿لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي﴾ i.e. other than me, like {فَمَنْ يَهْدِيهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ اللَّهِ}, i.e. other than Allah. ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ﴾

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً﴾ gentle ﴿حَيْثُ أَصَابَ﴾ wherever he wished,

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ﴾ who builds wondrous buildings ﴿وَغَوَّاصٍ﴾ in the sea, bringing out pearls,

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَآخَرِينَ﴾ of them ﴿مُقَرَّنِينَ﴾ bound ﴿فِي الْأَصْفَادِ﴾ fetters, with their hands joined to their necks. And We said to him:

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿هَذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ﴾ give from it to whomever you wish ﴿أَوْ أَمْسِكْ﴾ from giving ﴿بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ﴾ i.e. there is no reckoning upon you in that.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَى وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ﴾ Its like has preceded.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي﴾ i.e. "that I" [بِأَنِّي] ﴿مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ﴾ with harm ﴿وَعَذَابٍ﴾ pain. He ascribed that to Satan, even though all things are from Allah, out of courtesy towards Him, Exalted is He. And it was said to him:

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿ارْكُضْ﴾ strike ﴿بِرِجْلِكَ﴾ the ground. So he struck, and a spring of water gushed forth, and it was said: ﴿هَذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ﴾ water in which you wash ﴿بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ﴾ from which you drink. So he washed and drank, and every illness that was in his inside and outside left him.

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ﴾ i.e. Allah brought back to life those of his children who had died, and provided him with the like of them ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ a blessing ﴿مِنَّا وَذِكْرَى﴾ an admonition ﴿لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ﴾ for the possessors of intellect.

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا﴾ it is a bundle of grass or of rods ﴿فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ﴾ your wife; he had sworn that he would strike her a hundred blows because she was slow in coming to him one day ﴿وَلَا تَحْنَثْ﴾ by not striking her. So he took a hundred stalks of idhkhir (lemon grass) or something else and struck her with it a single blow. ﴿إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ﴾ Ayyūb ﴿إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ constantly returning to Allah the Exalted.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي﴾ possessors of strength in worship ﴿وَالْأَبْصَارِ﴾ insight in religion. In a reading [it is] [عَبْدَنَا], with "إِبْرَاهِيمُ" as an explication (bayān) of it, and what comes after it conjoined to "عَبْدَنَا".

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ﴾ it is ﴿ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ﴾ the Hereafter, i.e. remembering it and working for it. In a reading it is with iḍāfa (genitive construct), and it is explicative (li-l-bayān).

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ﴾ the chosen ﴿الْأَخْيَارِ﴾ the plural of khayyir, with doubling (tashdīd).

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ﴾ he is a prophet, and the lām is redundant (zāʾida) ﴿وَذَا الْكِفْلِ﴾ there is disagreement about his prophethood; it is said he gave protection (kafala) to a hundred prophets who fled to him from being killed ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾ i.e. all of them ﴿مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ﴾ the plural of khayyir, with the heavy [doubled] form.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿هَذَا ذِكْرٌ﴾ for them, with beautiful praise here ﴿وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ who include them ﴿لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ﴾ a [good] place of return in the Hereafter:

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of "حُسْنَ مَآبٍ" ﴿مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ﴾ of them,

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا﴾ on couches ﴿يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ﴾

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ﴾ restraining their eyes [to look only] at their husbands ﴿أَتْرَابٌ﴾ their ages are one, and they are thirty-three years old; the plural of tirb.

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿هَذَا﴾ what has been mentioned ﴿مَا يُوعَدُونَ﴾ in the third person, and in the second person [تُوعَدُونَ] by way of iltifāt (a shift of person) ﴿لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ﴾ i.e. for its sake.

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ﴾ i.e. cessation. The clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of "رِزْقُنَا", or a second khabar (predicate) of "إِنَّ", i.e. "continuing" [accusative] or "continuing" [nominative].

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿هَذَا﴾ what has been mentioned is for the believers. ﴿وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ﴾ resumptive (mustaʾnaf) ﴿لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ﴾

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا﴾ they enter it ﴿فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ﴾ the bed.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿هَذَا﴾ i.e. the punishment understood from what follows it ﴿فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ﴾ i.e. hot, scalding water ﴿وَغَسَاقٌ﴾ with the light and the doubled form [غَسَّاقٌ]: what flows from the pus of the people of the Fire.

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿وَأُخَرُ﴾ with the plural and the singular [آخَرُ] ﴿مِنْ شَكْلِهِ﴾ i.e. like what has been mentioned of the scalding water and the pus ﴿أَزْوَاجٌ﴾ kinds, i.e. their punishment is of various sorts. And it will be said to them, when they enter the Fire with their followers:

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿هَذَا فَوْجٌ﴾ a crowd ﴿مُقْتَحِمٌ﴾ entering ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ the Fire with violence. Then those who were followed will say: ﴿لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ﴾ may there be no ease for them ﴿إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ﴾

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ i.e. the followers ﴿بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ﴾ i.e. disbelief ﴿لَنَا فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ﴾ for us and you is the Fire.

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿قَالُوا﴾ also ﴿رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا﴾ i.e. the like of his punishment for his disbelief ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا﴾ the disbelievers of Mecca, while they are in the Fire ﴿مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَى رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ﴾ in the world ﴿مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ﴾

celaleyn:63-63.t: ﴿أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سُخْرِيًّا﴾ with ḍamma on the sīn and with kasra [سِخْرِيًّا], i.e. we used to mock them in the world; and the yāʾ is for relation (nisba). I.e. are they missing? ﴿أَمْ زَاغَتْ﴾ turned aside ﴿عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ﴾ so that we do not see them? They are the poor among the Muslims, such as ʿAmmār, Bilāl, Ṣuhayb and Salmān.

celaleyn:64-64.t: ﴿إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَحَقٌّ﴾ its occurrence is certain, and it is ﴿تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ﴾ as preceded.

celaleyn:65-65.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ O Muḥammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca: ﴿إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ﴾ one who warns of the Fire ﴿وَمَا مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ﴾ over His creation,

celaleyn:66-66.t: ﴿رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ﴾ prevailing in His affair ﴿الْغَفَّارُ﴾ to His friends.

celaleyn:68-68.t: ﴿أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ i.e. the Quran, about which I have informed you, and in which I have brought you what cannot be known except by revelation, namely His saying:

celaleyn:69-69.t: ﴿مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَى﴾ i.e. the angels ﴿إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ concerning Ādam, when Allah the Exalted said {إِنِّي جَاعِلٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً} etc.

celaleyn:70-70.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ not ﴿يُوحَى إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا﴾ i.e. that I am ﴿نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear in warning. Remember

celaleyn:71-71.t: ﴿إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ he is Ādam.

celaleyn:72-72.t: ﴿فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ﴾ I have completed him ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ﴾ I have made flow ﴿فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي﴾ so that he becomes alive. The attribution of the spirit to Him is an honouring of Ādam; and the spirit is a subtle body by which a human being lives through its permeating him. ﴿فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ﴾ a prostration of greeting, by bowing.

celaleyn:73-73.t: ﴿فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ In it there are two tawkīds (emphatic words).

celaleyn:74-74.t: ﴿إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ﴾ he is the father of the jinn, and he was among the angels ﴿اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾ in the knowledge of Allah the Exalted.

celaleyn:75-75.t: ﴿قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ﴾ i.e. whose creation I undertook [Myself]; and this is an honouring of Ādam, for every created thing is something whose creation Allah undertook. ﴿أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ﴾ now, from prostrating? An interrogative of rebuke. ﴿أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ﴾ the arrogant, so that you were too proud to prostrate because you are one of them?

celaleyn:76-76.t: ﴿قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:77-77.t: ﴿قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا﴾ i.e. from Paradise, and it is said: from the heavens ﴿فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ﴾ expelled.

celaleyn:78-78.t: ﴿وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ﴾ the Recompense.

celaleyn:79-79.t: ﴿قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ i.e. the people.

celaleyn:80-80.t: ﴿قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:81-81.t: ﴿إِلَى يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ﴾ the time of the first blast.

celaleyn:82-82.t: ﴿قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:83-83.t: ﴿إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ i.e. the believers.

celaleyn:84-84.t: ﴿قَالَ فَالْحَقَّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ﴾ with both in the accusative, and with the first in the nominative [فَالْحَقُّ] and the second in the accusative. The accusative of it [the second] is by the verb after it. The accusative of the first is said to be by the mentioned verb; and it is said to be as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "I establish the truth"; and it is said to be by removal of the particle of the oath. Its nominative is on the basis that it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "So the truth is from Me"; and it is said: "So the truth is My oath". And the jawāb (answer) of the oath is:

celaleyn:85-85.t: ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ﴾ with your offspring ﴿وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ﴾ i.e. of the people ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾

celaleyn:86-86.t: ﴿قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ﴾ for conveying the message ﴿مِنْ أَجْرٍ﴾ any fee ﴿وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ﴾ who fabricate the Quran of their own accord.

celaleyn:87-87.t: ﴿إِنْ هُوَ﴾ i.e. the Quran is not ﴿إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ﴾ an admonition ﴿لِلْعَالَمِينَ﴾ for humans and jinn, those endowed with reason, to the exclusion of the angels.

celaleyn:88-88.t: ﴿وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ﴾ O disbelievers of Mecca ﴿نَبَأَهُ﴾ the news of its truthfulness ﴿بَعْدَ حِينٍ﴾ i.e. on the Day of Resurrection. "عَلِمَ" has the meaning of "عَرَفَ" ("to know, recognise"), and the lām before it is the lām of an implied oath, i.e. "By Allah".

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿يا داوُدُ﴾ يا is the vocative particle, and a single proper-noun munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the vocative clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿جَعَلْناكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿خَلِيفَةً﴾ its second object. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a naʿt (adjective) of خليفة. ﴿فَاحْكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb whose agent is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلا﴾ a conjunction, and lā of prohibition. ﴿تَتَّبِعِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā, its agent latent. ﴿الْهَوى﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَيُضِلَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an; the kāf is its object and the agent is latent. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to يضلك. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿يَضِلُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to يضلون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿شَدِيدٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from mā and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the two are attached to عذاب. ﴿نَسُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:27-28.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and mā is negative. ﴿خَلَقْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to السماء. ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿باطِلًا﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ظَنُّ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to the omitted khabar. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second khabar. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نَجْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ its first object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), the second object of نجعل, and المفسدين is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to المفسدين. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نَجْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its agent latent. ﴿الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ its first object. ﴿كَالْفُجَّارِ﴾ the kāf is its second object and الفجار is muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:29-31.t: ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هذا". ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنزلناه. ﴿مُبارَكٌ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿لِيَدَّبَّرُوا﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ﴾ its i'rab is like ليدبروا; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to أنزلنا. ﴿أُولُوا﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the statement is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its agent. ﴿لِداوُدَ﴾ the two are attached to وهبنا. ﴿سُلَيْمانَ﴾ its object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿نِعْمَ﴾ an inflexible (jāmid) past verb. ﴿الْعَبْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for the clause of نعم. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿عُرِضَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to عرض. ﴿بِالْعَشِيِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الصَّافِناتُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْجِيادُ﴾ an adjective; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:32-34.t: ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb with a latent agent. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the verbal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so it is in the position of genitive. ﴿أَحْبَبْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿حُبَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿الْخَيْرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أحببت. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿تَوارَتْ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) agent. ﴿بِالْحِجابِ﴾ the two are attached to توارت. ﴿رُدُّوها﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is its agent and hā is its object; the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿عَلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to ردوها. ﴿فَطَفِقَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb of the verbs of beginning (afʿāl al-shurūʿ); its noun is latent, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مَسْحاً﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the implied verbal clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of طفق. ﴿بِالسُّوقِ﴾ plural of ساق; the two are attached to مسحا. ﴿وَالْأَعْناقِ﴾ conjoined to السوق. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and a preposition, the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَتَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿سُلَيْمانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to فتنا. ﴿عَلى كُرْسِيِّهِ﴾ the two are attached to ألقينا. ﴿جَسَداً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنابَ﴾ a past verb with a latent agent; the clause is conjoined to ألقينا.

daas-irab:35-38.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) with an omitted vocative particle, annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿اغْفِرْ﴾ a verb of supplication, its agent latent. ﴿لِي﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to اغفر. ﴿وَهَبْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a verb of supplication, its agent latent. ﴿لِي﴾ the two are attached to هب. ﴿مُلْكاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَنْبَغِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent. ﴿لِأَحَدٍ﴾ the two are attached to ينبغي; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ملكا. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِي﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of أحد. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْوَهَّابُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; the nominal clause gives the reason for the supplication. ﴿فَسَخَّرْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to سخرنا. ﴿الرِّيحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, with a latent agent; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾ the two are attached to تجري. ﴿رُخاءً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to تجري. ﴿أَصابَ﴾ a past verb with a latent agent; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَالشَّياطِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الشياطين is conjoined to الريح. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ badal (substitute) of الشياطين. ﴿بَنَّاءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَغَوَّاصٍ﴾ conjoined to بناء. ﴿وَآخَرِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and آخرين is conjoined to كل. ﴿مُقَرَّنِينَ﴾ an adjective of آخرين. ﴿فِي الْأَصْفادِ﴾ the two are attached to مقرنين.

daas-irab:39-42.t: ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَطاؤُنا﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿فَامْنُنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَمْسِكْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the verbal clause امنن is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position, and the clause أمسك is conjoined to امنن, with no grammatical position like it. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to عطاؤنا. ﴿حِسابٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنا لَزُلْفى وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿عَبْدَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيُّوبَ﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to اذكر. ﴿نادى﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنِّي﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿مَسَّنِيَ﴾ a past verb; the nūn is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause مسني is the khabar of أني, and anna with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, and the two are attached to نادى. ﴿بِنُصْبٍ﴾ the two are attached to مسني. ﴿وَعَذابٍ﴾ conjoined to نصب. ﴿ارْكُضْ﴾ an imperative verb meaning "strike", its agent latent. ﴿بِرِجْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to اركض; the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿هذا﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُغْتَسَلٌ﴾ its khabar. ﴿بارِدٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of مغتسل. ﴿وَشَرابٌ﴾ conjoined to it.

daas-irab:43-45.t: ﴿وَوَهَبْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to وهبنا. ﴿أَهْلَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمِثْلَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أهله. ﴿مَعَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, its naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَذِكْرى﴾ conjoined to رحمة. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ the lām is a preposition and أولي is a noun, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of ذكرى. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَخُذْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿بِيَدِكَ﴾ the two are attached to خذ; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ضِغْثاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاضْرِبْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to اضرب. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ of prohibition. ﴿تَحْنَثْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿وَجَدْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason for اضرب. ﴿صابِراً﴾ the second object of وجدنا. ﴿نِعْمَ﴾ a past verb for expressing praise. ﴿الْعَبْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَوَّابٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause also gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿عِبادَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ ابراهيم is a badal (substitute) of عبادنا and what follows it is conjoined. ﴿أُولِي﴾ an adjective, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿الْأَيْدِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَبْصارِ﴾ conjoined to الأيدي.

daas-irab:46-50.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَخْلَصْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause gives the reason for the command. ﴿بِخالِصَةٍ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أخلصناهم. ﴿ذِكْرَى﴾ badal (substitute) of خالصة. ﴿الدَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and inna and its noun; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿عِنْدَنا﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and min is a preposition. ﴿الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ﴾ a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar of إنهم. ﴿الْأَخْيارِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿إِسْماعِيلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْيَسَعَ﴾ conjoined to إسماعيل. ﴿وَذَا الْكِفْلِ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of the ḥāl, and كل is a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنَ الْأَخْيارِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿هذا﴾ the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿لَحُسْنَ﴾ the shifted lām, and its postponed noun. ﴿مَآبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause of inna is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿جَنَّاتِ﴾ badal of حسن. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُفَتَّحَةً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ the two are attached to مفتحة. ﴿الْأَبْوابُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive participle مفتحة.

daas-irab:51-55.t: ﴿مُتَّكِئِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to متكئين. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to يدعون. ﴿بِفاكِهَةٍ﴾ the two are also attached to يدعون. ﴿كَثِيرَةٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَشَرابٍ﴾ conjoined to فاكهة. ﴿وَعِنْدَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an adverb of place, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿قاصِراتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الطَّرْفِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَتْرابٌ﴾ an adjective of قاصرات. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾ khabar. ﴿تُوعَدُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿لِيَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to توعدون. ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause توعدون is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَرِزْقُنا﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and رزقنا is its khabar. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَفادٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause of inna and what follows it is the object of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿هذا﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِلطَّاغِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar of inna. ﴿لَشَرَّ﴾ the shifted lām, and شر is its postponed noun; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَآبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:56-60.t: ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ badal (substitute) of شر. ﴿يَصْلَوْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَبِئْسَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an inflexible (jāmid) past verb. ﴿الْمِهادُ﴾ its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the wāw is its agent and the hāʾ its object. ﴿حَمِيمٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ هذا. ﴿وَغَسَّاقٌ﴾ conjoined to it. ﴿وَآخَرُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and آخر is conjoined to حميم. ﴿مِنْ شَكْلِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of آخر. ﴿أَزْواجٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي أزواج". ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَوْجٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مُقْتَحِمٌ﴾ an adjective of فوج. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿لا﴾ negative; the nominal clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying. ﴿مَرْحَباً﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to مرحبا; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿صالُوا﴾ its khabar, nominative by the wāw. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its agent. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿مَرْحَباً﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to مرحبا. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached to قدمتموه. ﴿فَبِئْسَ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an inflexible past verb. ﴿الْقَرارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:61-63.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قَدَّمَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent (mustatir). ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to قدم. ﴿هذا﴾ the demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَزِدْهُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb and its first object. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ its second object. ﴿ضِعْفاً﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of عذابا. ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second adjective of عذابا; the clause زده is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿نَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ما لنا is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿رِجالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and its noun. ﴿نَعُدُّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and its object, its agent latent; the clause is the khabar of كنا, and the clause كنا is an adjective of رجالا. ﴿مِنَ الْأَشْرارِ﴾ the two are attached to نعدهم. ﴿أَتَّخَذْناهُمْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and a past verb, its agent and its first object. ﴿سِخْرِيًّا﴾ its second object; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿زاغَتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَنْهُمُ﴾ the two are attached to زاغت. ﴿الْأَبْصارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause زاغت is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:64-68.t: ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَحَقٌّ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and حق is its khabar (predicate). ﴿تَخاصُمُ﴾ badal (substitute) of حق. ﴿أَهْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿النَّارِ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُنْذِرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ «[Translator's note: the source calls إله here "لفظ الجلالة" (the Name of Majesty); the word parsed is the common noun إله "god".]». ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْواحِدُ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿الْقَهَّارُ﴾ a second adjective; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَبُّ﴾ badal of the Name of Majesty. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات. ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to الأرض. ﴿بَيْنَهُمَا﴾ an adverb of place; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and mā is the sign of the dual. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿الْغَفَّارُ﴾ a second adjective. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿نَبَأٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ an adjective; the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to معرضون. ﴿مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is a second adjective of نبأ.

daas-irab:69-72.t: ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ a noun genitive in form, nominative in position, its postponed noun. ﴿بِالْمَلَإِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to علم. ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الملأ. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿يَخْتَصِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause of كان is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿يُوحى﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to يوحى; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنَّما﴾ the restraining mā and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أنما and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يوحى. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿إِذْ﴾ accusative (manṣūb) by the omitted verb اذكر, or a badal (substitute). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾ the two are attached to قال; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿خالِقٌ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause is the object of a verb of saying. ﴿بَشَراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of خالق. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective of بشرا. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and إذا is an adverbial, non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿سَوَّيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿وَنَفَخْتُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so like it it is in the position of genitive. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to نفخت. ﴿مِنْ رُوحِي﴾ the two are attached to نفخت. ﴿فَقَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb and its agent; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to ساجدين. ﴿ساجِدِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative.

daas-irab:73-75.t: ﴿فَسَجَدَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿كُلُّهُمْ﴾ a first tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿أَجْمَعُونَ﴾ a second tawkīd. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾ excepted by إلا, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿اسْتَكْبَرَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and its noun is latent, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿يا﴾ the vocative particle. ﴿إِبْلِيسُ﴾ a proper-noun munādā (the one addressed), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma. ﴿ما﴾ interrogative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the vocative clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿مَنَعَكَ﴾ a past verb and its object, its agent latent; the clause is the khabar of ما. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿تَسْجُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, its agent latent. ﴿لِما﴾ the lām is a preposition and mā is a relative noun, genitive; the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to تسجد; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by an implied preposition. ﴿خَلَقْتُ﴾ a past verb and its agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِيَدَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to خلقت. ﴿أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving, rebuking interrogation, and a past verb and its agent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ an incomplete past verb and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْعالِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:76-79.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying), and the verbal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to خير. ﴿خَلَقْتَنِي﴾ a past verb, its agent and its object, and the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿مِنْ نارٍ﴾ the two are attached to خلقتني. ﴿وَخَلَقْتَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its agent and its object. ﴿مِنْ طِينٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَاخْرُجْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ of the implied condition), and an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to اخرج. ﴿فَإِنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of causation (taʿlīl), and inna and its noun. ﴿رَجِيمٌ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause gives the reason, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is of the ḥāl (circumstantial), and inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are its fronted khabar. ﴿لَعْنَتِي﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿الدِّينِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness. ﴿فَأَنْظِرْنِي﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and a verb of supplication and its object, the agent latent, and the nūn is for protection; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿يُبْعَثُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:80-84.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and inna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar (predicate) of inna; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to أنظرني «[Translator's note: so in the source; أنظرني occurs in the previous ayah, and in this ayah the nearest governing word is المنظرين.]». ﴿الْوَقْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمَعْلُومِ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الوقت. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَبِعِزَّتِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant; the bāʾ is a preposition and a particle of oath, and عزتك is genitive by the bāʾ; the two are attached to the omitted verb of the oath. ﴿لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb, its agent latent and its object the hāʾ; it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis); the clause أغويناهم «[Translator's note: so in the source, for لأغوينهم.]» is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عِبادَكَ﴾ excepted, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿مِنْهُمُ﴾ the two are attached to what follows them. ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ an adjective of عبادك, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its agent latent. ﴿فَالْحَقُّ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted. ﴿وَالْحَقَّ﴾ a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أقول. ﴿أَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent; the clause الحق أقول is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:85-88.t: ﴿لَأَمْلَأَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنْكَ﴾ the two are attached (mutaʿalliq) to the verb. ﴿وَمِمَّنْ﴾ conjoined to منك. ﴿تَبِعَكَ﴾ a past verb and its object, with a latent agent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of مَن, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its agent latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its agent latent, and the kāf is its first object; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنْ أَجْرٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and أجر is genitive in form, accusative in position, the second object of أسألكم. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is the Ḥijāzī negative mā, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ﴾ أنا is its noun and the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so it is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿هُوَ﴾ the pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to ذكر; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is in the response to an oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, which is omitted because of the succession of like letters; the wāw of the plural, omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns, is its agent, and the nūn of emphasis has no grammatical position. ﴿نَبَأَهُ﴾ its object. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿حِينٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the verbal clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:1-3.t:
﴿ص﴾ a letter with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْقُرْآنِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath; القرآن is genitive by the wāw of oath, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb أقسم (I swear). ﴿ذِي﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of القرآن, genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿الذِّكْرِ﴾
muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the answer of the oath is omitted. ﴿بَلِ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي عِزَّةٍ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَشِقاقٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and شقاق is conjoined to عزة; the nominal clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَمْ﴾ predicative (khabariyya), in the position of accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أهلكنا. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ both attached to أهلكنا. ﴿مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ tamyīz (specification) of كم. ﴿فَنادَوْا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿وَلاتَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and لات is a particle resembling ليس and working like it; its noun is omitted, the implied form being "ليس الحين" (the time is not). ﴿حِينَ﴾ its khabar, accusative. ﴿مَناصٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause نادوا is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position, and the clause of the defective verb is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:10-13.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السموات; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is a relative pronoun conjoined to السموات. ﴿بَيْنَهُما﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿فَلْيَرْتَقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, the lām is the lām of command, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَسْبابِ﴾ both attached to يرتقوا. ﴿جُنْدٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿هُنالِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of a naʿt (adjective), and the hāʾ is for calling attention (tanbīh). [Translator's note: so in the source, although هنالك has no hāʾ of tanbīh.] ﴿مَهْزُومٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِنَ الْأَحْزابِ﴾ both attached to مهزوم. ﴿كَذَّبَتْ﴾ a past verb. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿قَوْمُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعادٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَفِرْعَوْنُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿ذُو﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of فرعون, nominative with the wāw. ﴿الْأَوْتادِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَثَمُودُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ثمود is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقَوْمُ﴾ also conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَصْحابُ﴾ also conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; and ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is a badal (substitute) from what precedes it. ﴿الْأَحْزابُ﴾ a badal from أولئك.

daas-irab:14-17.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الرُّسُلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَحَقَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿عِقابِ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative with a ḍamma [implied] on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, which is dropped to observe the verse-ending (fāṣila). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle and ما is negating. ﴿يَنْظُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ the demonstrative is its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿صَيْحَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of صيحة. ﴿ما﴾ negating, working like ليس. ﴿لَها﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿فَواقٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, the noun of ما; the clause is in the position of accusative as a second ṣifa of صيحة. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ a munādā (the one addressed) that is muḍāf. ﴿عَجِّلْ﴾ a verb of supplication, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لَنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) عجل; the vocative clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause قالوا is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿قِطَّنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحِسابِ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اصْبِرْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to اصبر. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَاذْكُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَبْدَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿داوُدَ﴾ a badal (substitute) from it. ﴿ذَا﴾ a ṣifa of داود. ﴿الْأَيْدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَوَّابٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:18-21.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿سَخَّرْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْجِبالَ﴾ its object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يُسَبِّحْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِالْعَشِيِّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسبحن. ﴿وَالْإِشْراقِ﴾ conjoined to العشي; the nominal clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالطَّيْرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and الطير is conjoined to الجبال. ﴿مَحْشُورَةً﴾ a ḥāl, accusative. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to the khabar. ﴿أَوَّابٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿وَشَدَدْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُلْكَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is conjoined to سخرنا, so like it, it is in the position of nominative. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its first object. ﴿الْحِكْمَةَ﴾ its second object; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so like it, it too is in the position of nominative. ﴿وَفَصْلَ﴾ conjoined to الحكمة. ﴿الْخِطابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهَلْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and هل is a particle of interrogation and wonder. ﴿أَتاكَ نَبَأُ﴾ a past verb, its object and its fāʿil. ﴿الْخَصْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿تَسَوَّرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمِحْرابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation to the adverb, and the clause أتاك is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:22-23.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ a badal (substitute) from the preceding إذ. ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى داوُدَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) دخلوا; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَفَزِعَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to فزع; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, so like it, it is in the position of genitive. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَخَفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil latent. ﴿خَصْمانِ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with the alif because it is dual; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَغى﴾ a past verb. ﴿بَعْضُنا﴾ fāʿil. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ both attached to بغى; the clause بغى is a ṣifa (adjective) of خصمان. ﴿فَاحْكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to احكم. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تُشْطِطْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive; the clause is conjoined to احكم, with no grammatical position, and the clause احكم is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاهْدِنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اهدنا is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and نا is its object. ﴿إِلى سَواءِ﴾ both attached to اهدنا. ﴿الصِّراطِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to تشطط, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَخِي﴾ its khabar; the clause is the maqūl of the omitted verb of saying. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, a fronted khabar. ﴿تِسْعٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَتِسْعُونَ﴾ conjoined to تسع, nominative with the wāw; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿نَعْجَةً﴾ tamyīz (specification), accusative. ﴿وَلِيَ﴾ also a fronted khabar. ﴿نَعْجَةً﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿واحِدَةٌ﴾ a ṣifa of نعجة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قال is a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَكْفِلْنِيها﴾ an imperative verb and its first object, and the hāʾ is its second object; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَعَزَّنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its object. ﴿فِي الْخِطابِ﴾ both attached to عزني; the clause is conjoined to قال, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-25.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); the clause قال is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿ظَلَمَكَ﴾ a past verb and its latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is its object. ﴿بِسُؤالِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ظلمك. ﴿نَعْجَتِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلى نِعاجِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْخُلَطاءِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are a ṣifa (adjective) of كثيرا; the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَيَبْغِي﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) [Translator's note: the source misprints it as «اللازم»], and an imperfect verb. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾ both attached to يبغي; the clause يبغي is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾ conjoined to آمنوا. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَقَلِيلٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and قليل is a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, a ṣifa. [Translator's note: so in the source; ما here is usually parsed as redundant (zāʾida).] ﴿هُمْ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَظَنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿داوُدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّما﴾ a restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle. ﴿فَتَنَّاهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and its object; أنما with the verb stands in place of the two objects of ظن. ﴿فَاسْتَغْفَرَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and استغفر is a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to ظن, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَخَرَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿راكِعاً﴾
ḥāl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَنابَ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and أناب is a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَغَفَرْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to غفرنا. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the fronted khabar of إنّ. ﴿عِنْدَنا﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿لَزُلْفى﴾ the shifted lām and the postponed noun of إنّ. ﴿وَحُسْنَ﴾ conjoined to زلفى. ﴿مَآبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:4-6.t: ﴿وَعَجِبُوا﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْ﴾ maṣdariyya; it and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by an omitted preposition. ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object. ﴿مُنْذِرٌ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of منذر. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the wāw; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ساحِرٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿كَذَّابٌ﴾ a second khabar. ﴿أَجَعَلَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿الْآلِهَةَ﴾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلهاً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِداً﴾ a ṣifa; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَشَيْءٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and شيء is its khabar. ﴿عُجابٌ﴾ a ṣifa of شيء. ﴿وَانْطَلَقَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾ its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنِ﴾ maṣdariyya; it and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of accusative as the maqūl of the omitted verb of saying. ﴿امْشُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَاصْبِرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى آلِهَتِكُمْ﴾ both attached to اصبروا. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَشَيْءٌ﴾ the shifted lām, and شيء is its khabar; the clause gives the reason for اصبروا. ﴿يُرادُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent; the clause is a ṣifa of شيء.

daas-irab:7-9.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِهذا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) سمعنا. ﴿فِي الْمِلَّةِ﴾ both attached to سمعنا. ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اخْتِلاقٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿أَأُنْزِلَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (inkārī), and a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to أنزل. ﴿الذِّكْرُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِنا﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي شَكٍّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ ذِكْرِي﴾ a ṣifa of شك. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] (qalb) and of the jussive. ﴿يَذُوقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لما, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَذابِ﴾ its object. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿عِنْدَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿خَزائِنُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَحْمَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ a second muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ a ṣifa of ربك. ﴿الْوَهَّابِ﴾ a second ṣifa; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, with no grammatical position.

dervis-irab:21-25.t:
* Vocabulary:
(تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرابَ): They set out for its wall and climbed down from the top of it. The sūr is the high wall. The word المحراب has been explained earlier. And الخصم means the disputant and the contender; it may be applied to two persons, to a plural and to a feminine, so one says "the two of them are a khaṣm", "they are a khaṣm" and "she is a khaṣm", because in origin it is a maṣdar (verbal noun). A parallel has already come up, namely ضيف in the verse «حديث ضيف ابراهيم المكرمين».
(وَلا تُشْطِطْ): "and do not act unjustly". It is read with ḍamma on the tāʾ, sukūn on the shīn and kasra on the first ṭāʾ, from ashṭaṭa, yushṭiṭu, ishṭāṭan, when one oversteps the limit. Abū ʿUbayda said: "shaṭaṭtu fī l-ḥukm and ashṭaṭtu fīhi" when you act unjustly; so it is among the verbs in which the forms faʿala and afʿala agree.
(سَواءِ الصِّراطِ): the middle of the road, the right course and its highway.
(أَكْفِلْنِيها): "make me her guarantor"; what is meant is "give her to me in possession". In al-Mukhtār: "kafala ʿanhu bi-l-māl li-gharīmihi, and akfalahu l-māl, I made him responsible for it; and kafalahu iyyāhu, with light fā', so he is kāfil, of the pattern naṣara and dakhala; and kaffalahu iyyāhu takfīlan is the same."
(وَعَزَّنِي): "and he overcame me in the dispute", and brought arguments that I am unable to refute. In al-Mukhtār: "ʿazza ʿalayhi: he overcame him, and its pattern is radda. In the proverb «man ʿazza bazza», that is, whoever overcomes plunders. The noun is al-ʿizza, which is strength and mastery. ʿazzahu fī l-khiṭāb and ʿāzzahu mean he overcame him." Majnūn Laylā said:
قطاة عزها شرك فباتت ... تجاذبه وقد علق الجناح
(A sandgrouse caught by a snare spent the night pulling against it, its wing entangled.)
And before it:
كأن القلب ليلة قيل يغدى ... بليلى العامرية أو يراح
(As if the heart, on the night it was said that Laylā of the ʿĀmir tribe would depart in the morning or the evening...)
He likened his heart, when he heard of her departure, to a dove whose wing the snare has seized, in the abundance of its fluttering.
(الْخُلَطاءِ): the partners who have mingled their property; the singular is khalīṭ.
Now, the lexicons have given several meanings for khalīṭ, among them: the one who mixes with, the partner, the people whose affair is one, the spouse, the neighbour and the companion; and a man's khalīṭ is the one who mixes with him, like jalīs, the one who sits with him.

* I'rab:
(وَهَلْ أَتاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرابَ) A resumptive discourse, introduced to relate the story of Dāwūd. هل is a particle of interrogation whose meaning is wonder and eagerness to hear what follows, as you say to the one you address: "Do you know what happened today?" and then tell him what happened. أتاك نبأ الخصم: a past verb, a fronted direct object (mafʿūl bihi) and a postponed agent (fāʿil). إذ is an adverbial for an omitted muḍāf, that is, "the report of the disputing of the disputants when they climbed". The wording of al-Zamakhsharī: "If you say: to what is إذ governed in the accusative? I say: it cannot be other than governed by أتاك, or by النبأ, or by something omitted. It is not permissible that it be governed by أتاك, because the coming of the report to the Messenger of Allah can occur only in his own time, not in the time of Dāwūd; nor by النبأ, because the coming of the report took place in the time of Dāwūd, so its coming to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not be correct; and if you meant by النبأ the story itself, it would not be a governor. So it remains that it is accusative by an omitted word, its implied form being: 'and has the report of the disputants' going to law reached you, when…'. It is also possible that it is governed by الخصم because of the sense of a verb it contains." The clause تسوروا is what the adverbial is annexed to; تسوروا is a past verb and agent, and المحراب is a direct object.
(إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلى داوُدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ) إذ is a badal (substitute) for the first إذ, and the clause دخلوا is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverbial to it. على داود: the two are attached to دخلوا. The فاء is a conjunction; فزع is a past verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; منهم: the two are attached to فزع. (قالُوا لا تَخَفْ خَصْمانِ بَغى بَعْضُنا عَلى بَعْضٍ) The clause is resumptive, introduced as an answer to a question arising from the report of his fright, as if it were said: "So what did they say when they saw the signs of fright imprinted on his face?" So he said: "They said…". لا is prohibitive; تخف is an imperfect verb jussive (majzūm) by لا, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; خصمان is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), that is, "we are two disputants"; the clause بغى is an adjective of خصمان; بعضنا is the agent; على بعض: the two are attached to بغى. (فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنا بِالْحَقِّ وَلا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنا إِلى سَواءِ الصِّراطِ) The فاء is the eloquent fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); احكم is an imperative verb with a latent agent; بيننا is an adverbial attached to احكم; بالحق is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or both are attached to احكم as well. ولا تشطط is conjoined to احكم; واهد is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter, with a latent agent whose implied form is "you"; نا is a direct object; إلى سواء الصراط: the two are attached to اهدنا.
(إِنَّ هذا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ واحِدَةٌ) إن and its noun; أخي is a badal from هذا, or the khabar of إن; له is a fronted khabar; تسع is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the khabar of إن or a second khabar; تسعون is conjoined to تسع; نعجة is a tamyīz (specification); لي is a fronted khabar; نعجة is a postponed mubtadaʾ; واحدة is an adjective. The matter of the metaphorical use of "ewe" will come in the section on rhetoric.
(فَقالَ أَكْفِلْنِيها وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطابِ) The فاء is a conjunction; قال is a past verb; the clause أكفلنيها, made up of the verb, the latent agent and the two objects, is the quoted speech; وعزني is conjoined to فقال; في الخطاب: the two are attached to عزني. (قالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلى نِعاجِهِ) The lām introduces the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation; ظلمك is a verb with a latent agent, and the كاف is a direct object; بسؤال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ظلمك; نعجتك is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive), as an annexation of the maṣdar to its object, the agent being omitted, that is, "by his asking you for your ewe"; إلى نعاجه: the two are attached to an omitted word whose implied form is "to add it". (وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً مِنَ الْخُلَطاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلى بَعْضٍ) The wāw is a conjunction, and it may also be a ḥāl wāw; إن and its noun; من الخلطاء is an adjective of كثيرا; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يبغي بعضهم: an imperfect verb and agent; على بعض: the two are attached to يبغي. (إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ ما هُمْ) إلا is a particle of exception; الذين is a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause); عملوا is conjoined to آمنوا; الصالحات is a direct object; the wāw is a ḥāl wāw; قليل is a fronted khabar; ما is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasizing the fewness; هم is a postponed mubtadaʾ.
(وَظَنَّ داوُدُ أَنَّما فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ راكِعاً وَأَنابَ) Conjoined to an omitted clause, that is, "the two angels said: the man has given judgement against himself, so he realized". وظن داود: a verb and agent; إنما: the particle kāffa (restraining) and the restrained one (makfūfa), and it together with what follows it takes the place of the two objects of ظن; وفتناه: a past verb, agent and direct object; فاستغفر is conjoined to وظن; ربه is a direct object; وخر is also conjoined, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he"; راكعا is a ḥāl; وأناب is also conjoined. (فَغَفَرْنا لَهُ ذلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنا لَزُلْفى وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ) Also conjoined; غفرنا is a verb and agent; له: the two are attached to غفرنا; ذلك is a direct object, that is, that sin. And إن: the wāw is a conjunction, and أن is a particle resembling the verb; له is a fronted khabar; عندنا is an adverbial attached to an omitted word, in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; the lām is the shifted lām; زلفى is the noun of إن; وحسن مآب is conjoined to زلفى.

* Rhetoric:
In the words «إن هذا أخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة واحدة» the verse contains a kināya (allusion) for the woman, for they used to allude to a woman by the ewe and the sheep, as in the saying of ʿAntara:
يا شاة ما قنص لمن حلت له ... حرمت علي وليتها لم تحرم
(O sheep, what a prey for the one to whom you are lawful! You were made forbidden to me, and would that you had not been forbidden.)
He only meant the wife of his father, whom he loved; and it is said that she was his slave girl, so he made her unlawful for himself.
